body: Here’s your rating. Why would an App ask for a review be ever letting me see what is does. 7 day trials are a scam, IMHO

title: Worst App
body: Low accuracy, hard to use, no reception.

title: Very bad app
body: Was very glitchy and very slow waste of money

title: Settings doesn’t work and skips
body: For about a day I was able to use the settings to change my implement width, now the settings have disappeared and it just says 50ft and there is no buttons to click anymore- very frustrating and a waste of money

title: Don’t waste your money!
body: Out of curiosity I tried the trial . Never got notified on the 5th day to cancel . Absolute junk! Not even within 10 foot of accurate.

title: Disappointed
body: Wanted a review before you even see it. Makes you sign up for 7 day trial to even see it. I feel like they hope you don’t take the time to cancel. No thanks

title: Supposedly updates coming
body: I have read many of the reviews suggesting or complaining about being able to use a light bar or an external antenna, the only feedback the developer leaves is for 4&5 star critical reviews. Its coming soon is the common reply starting back in April, well it is almost October and nothing. I used the app for the trial period and canceled since I did not like the lack of accuracy and other features I would expect for a $90 yearly subscription. The negative reviews seem accurate and the positive reviews do not. Possibly paying some company for bogus reviews. If I see some actual meaningful and useful updates that allow this app to preform close to what’s currently claimed I may adjust this review, but not holding my breath.

title: Forced review
body: and make you give it five stars before you realize it’s a paid subscription

title: Not worth paying for
body: App has no user guide. Features are spartan. For US $89 l expect more. Don’t waist your time on this app - unfortunately I did.

title: Insufficient
body: Not even close. Was hopeful, but no deal

title: Zoom doesn’t work and charged before 7days
body: This app is not recommended for small food plots, it will not zoom in closer enough. It will not stay on track and it will not stay open on your phone so I removed the app and on day three it charged me for one year before I got a chance to cancel itcould not get it to work on even a 6 acre food plot for spraying chemicals

title: This app can’t do what everyone saying!
body: This app can’t do any of the things people are saying it can! Scam .. this app gives no direction and it’s a waste of time!

title: Garbage like all the rest
body: Beyond inaccurate, made a few passes following the A B line on the app and it looked like Stevie wonder was driving my tractor

title: Not happy
body: Not very happy with this app there seem to be a leg behind my location and where I was on the tractor. Also, when I was using the tractor and going underneath trees, my location would disappear.

title: Glitch
body: It’s nice when it worked but it would keep glitching and closing to app loosing my progress .

title: Ok, hope for further development
body: Good : It tracks and displays where you’ve been on a satellite photo. Needs further development : Implement width should not default back to 52’ every use. Stop adding acres when the “stop” button has been hit. Turn off A/B lines as desired. Needs option to output data channel to Google Earth for permanent record keeping.

title: Instructions would be handy
body: Would be nice to have some instructions on how to use it. Can’t get it to work

title: Design could use some work.
body: The clear tracks option should not be on the open page. While spraying I tapped it by accident and lost all of what I had done.

title: Does a simple GPS app really need a subscription? $89/year
body: For those of you who are wondering, app costs $89/yr after a 7 day free trial. Seems expensive to me, so I just deleted the app. Does every simple app really need to be a subscription? Just 8 years ago, $89 bought you a lifetime quickbooks subscription you could run your entire business on. I think this app should cost around $20 for a lifetime version.

title: GPS could be better
body: The functionality of the app is great however the gps does drift +-4’. I was in an open field with an iPhone 17. Would be a great app if the accuracy was better

title: Seems good but cell coverage is an issue
body: I got this to spray weeds but first time trying the app realized the area I was spraying has bad to no cell coverage. This made the tracking jump around the pasture and was unusable. Honestly the app looks great and seems user friendly. Adding some links to tutorials would be helpful but being somewhat tech savvy I was able to figure it out. Just wish AT&T were better where I live.

title: Jeremy
body: GPS is slow

title: A to b
body: Just started out this could be a game changer for my operation

title: A
body: Seems to not be real accurate at times when you quit a field and come back to it a couple days later. But worth the money

title: The free trial was worth it
body: Gave the free trial a try. Worked better than nothing. If I was going to pay for it, I’d like it to have a light bar system to help get on the line. Also wish you could zoom the screen in a little closer. Thanks for a pretty good little app.

title: App Question
body: Is there any way to connect to an external gps receiver to enhance the position in the app? iPhone signal may be adequate, but may be interested in getting some more accuracy if possible. Thanks

title: Good App but Too Expensive
body: I used the app for the first time yesterday to fertilize a 20 ac hay field, and it was great! The only mild complaint about the functionality is that the speed tracker is inconsistent. I cancelled my subscription because $90/year is too high for the twice a year that I will fertilize. Can a subscription plan be created for us smaller users? I’m in for $20.

title: Almost perfect
body: The thing works great. I’m using my uTV and my sprayer with a 10 foot boom. Couple things that would make it better is loud beep when I go a little too fast or slow and a little guidance on some of the icons and settings like the AB circle on the screen and sometimes I have lines all the way down my field sometimes I don’t don’t know what they mean other than maybe I’m supposed to follow the line but there’s no instructions. Keep up the good work.

title: Spraying
body: I used the free trial on this to spray weeds and several fields worked good but due to rain I didn’t complete my spraying during the trial. I only need this for maybe a month or two out of the year for spraying and would appreciate a monthly option versus paying for a whole year

title: Great new product.
body: Really nice app just needs the save feature and it will save farmers thousands.

title: Question on Downloading Map
body: Are you able to download a map of your area so this app can be on a device that is not connected to Wi-Fi? This app works well on my iPhone but when I try to use on my iPad (that is connected to Wi-Fi thru my phone) the gps is all over this place. I am trying to use my iPad to see the screen better since my phone is so small. Thanks

title: Questions about it
body: I need to know how accurate the width guide is? If I set it to how wide the sprayer goes out does it really track that. Also how accurate is the speed tracker?

title: Optional
body: Optional

title: Exceeded Expectations!
body: I used the app for late winter pre emergent applications using boodles sprayer and was delighted by the ease of use. Just finished broadcasting fertilizer on my coastal field towing spreader in my F250. This saves time and money. Well worth it.

title: Great time saver!
body: This app has been such a time saver! From spraying, mowing, planting it’s so useful. No till drilling was a complete pain not having any idea if I had skips when planting in existing vegetation. Same goes with spraying guessing off of tire prints. It’s not inch accuracy but is pretty dang accurate! Love that you can go back into a job and finish up if you have to leave the field. Hopefully they can advance it adding an external GPS but works as intended. Very fair price for what you get out of the app.

title: Thank you
body: For a perfect app to track my land management

title: Price is right
body: This is an excellent program for the money. No tractor guidance integration or centimeter level accuracy, but for the average small farm it is great for spraying, and seeding where otherwise it is difficult to tell where you have been along.

title: Great App
body: A few things to add, the app needs to show your custom fields on the drive screen. Another useful feature would be to allow .gpx, .kml, and .shp files to be imported as fields.

title: GPS
body: Used this to fertlizer out today and spray it was spot on and easy to set up that even an old timer can use it like me .

title: Saved me $
body: I used this ap to fertilize several fields. It was so easy to use and I ended up not wasting or overlapping . I usually have too much fertilizer left over and have to go back and zig zag to use it up. It ended up just perfect as I ran out when I finished covering the field. What a neat tool

title: Just what I needed
body: Thank you

title: This app is EXTREMELY helpful
body: Downloaded it to try it out planting, saved me multiple times and made me more efficient! Firstly, you can leave spots and come back to them if they are on the way out of the field or something so you don’t spend more time chasing small passes to clean up a field (if that makes sense) also, you don’t have to try and remember places to come back to if you have irregular shaped fields like I do. Saved me when my pto pump came off and I realized I wasn’t planting 5 acres later, I had already made tracks so it would have been extremely hard to plant over it and not get messed up, but with the app I just deleted my track and started over! Also helped me at night, I strongly recommend this app if you’re like me and cover a lot of ground and don’t have gps systems. Considering paying for it I liked it so much. Edit here, paid for the app, very helpful, now I’m spraying and it puts me back to my Home Screen immediately when I hit start. Worked great yesterday so I’m not sure what going on. It did a similar thing to me before but I think they were updating the app, so maybe that’s what’s going on

title: Perfect for small farm
body: This app saved me from getting deeper into the high priced tractor GPS tech. The accuracy saves me on fuel, fertilizer, and seed. I would recommend this app to any farmer, especially smaller acreage.

title: Shockingly worked well!!
body: Didn’t have time to get our gps system back in so we figured why not, give this app a try with the free trial. This actually worked really well. My dad who has never used a gps system really liked how well it worked and it was very easy to use. No you don’t have jobs you can save and other features as a full system, but it’s a great option for those that want to learn how gps works first or even smaller acreage properties where it’s not cost worthy for a system. Hopefully there will be an option in the future that you can export your jobs (or we don’t have the option in the free trial) for record keeping. Super easy, non tech savvy users can even work it. Keeping our subscription and giving our kid an iPad to go work and color the lines.

title: Awesome app. Needs some features
body: Super helpful app in the hilly pastures of the Ozarks. Would be really nice to save tracks and make them different colors. At 600$ per ton this app pays for itself in the fertilizer you save by not covering twice

title: Exceptional
body: I planted 35 acres of grass seed using an old native grass planter. This program was amazing. Worked incredibly well.

title: Works great
body: Great app for areas with poor cell coverage as it allows you to download imagery in advance.

title: Great for small farmers
body: Great app have really been pleased, for future versions offset implements would be nice

title: Great app
body: I am using this app to assist when spraying larger areas of turf so that I’m not second guessing my tracks. It’s pretty easy to use. It’s a little bit pricey but can quickly pay for itself.

title: Great app
body: I used the free version to spray a total of 100 acres on 3 different plots. Very easy to use and very impressed with it. I have used a lot of different GPS units and this was as useful, if not better, as the $3000 dollar unit I had before. Will definitely be purchasing the app for next season.

title: Tractor GPS
body: Very responsive to questions, continue to upgrade app great customer service.

title: Great support
body: Very prompt and professional helping me resolve my problem

title: Just get it
body: This might be my first app review but I feel this one deserves it. I have used this app several times this year and no telling what it has saved me as a small time 40 acre cattle farmer. I just finished up spraying for army worms in the dark and couldn’t have done it without this app.

title: PHH
body: Great app. Love it.

title: Small Farmer approved
body: Had software for couple weeks. Have no intentions on canceling. This software is an incredible value for the small farmer on a tight budget. We have used it for fertilizer and spray and is very accurate. Family sharing allows my son to use it on our farm on his devise without separate subscription. Support also is awesome and prompt to answer any questions.

title: Super useful!
body: I have been using it for a couple of weeks and it is very useful. I was surprised how accurate the guidance is just using my phone. Anyway, you can’t go wrong for the price, a fraction of the cost of anything else.
